advisories.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
advisories.rationale: Metro reads repository-controlled mobile image assets during bundling. The affected parser is not loaded by the desktop beta or shipped mobile runtime, no patched image-size release exists, and untrusted asset bytes are not accepted by the application at runtime.

advisories.title: decode-uri-component: Denial of service via exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input
advisories.rationale: React Navigation 7 currently reaches the CommonJS query-string 7 line, which cannot consume the fixed ESM-only decoder. SkyTwin does not enable React Navigation URL linking and its active custom-scheme parser uses the platform decoder with bounded route shapes.
